title: Red Teaming Multimodal Language Models: Evaluating Harm Across Prompt Modalities and Models
reasoning: The paper identifies 'unethical behavior' as one of its three primary harm categories for evaluation and includes a specific dataset of 256 prompts designed to elicit such behavior. It utilizes a 5-point 'Harmfulness scale' to benchmark the ethical and moral impact of model responses, making this a central component of the study's safety evaluation.
